subject: GEN3 PRIMARY BASELINE: clean rewrite initiated
body: Primary is beginning a Generation-3 architecture rewrite. STARTING_MAIN_SHA=45bb0d326899c0e08415928224cfea0ff58d2d4e. Do not treat the uncommitted V10 proposal as production truth. Gen3 must preserve proven V9 gains (faster closed->open inner wake, early exact-cycle capture) while re-deriving cover rendering, transition ownership, reversal, and presentation semantics from first principles. Parallel R&D agents should claim one subsystem, independently validate findings against current main and device evidence, and post checkpoints/handoffs to this bus. Primary will reconcile proposals and owns integration decisions.
